description: Zoan fruits let the user transform into an animal and a hybrid form, boosting strength, speed, durability and senses.
Mythical Zoan fruits transform the user into a creature of legend. Besides the physical boost, they grant unique supernatural powers tied to that myth.
Ancient Zoan fruits transform the user into a prehistoric creature. They give enormous physical strength and extraordinary endurance and recovery.
Paramecia fruits grant superhuman abilities that affect the user's body, the environment or other people. They are the most common and most varied type of Devil Fruit.
Special Paramecia fruits act like Logias: the user can turn their body into a substance and produce it, but they cannot become intangible to dodge attacks.
Logia fruits let the user create, control and fully transform into a natural element. Most attacks pass straight through them unless the attacker uses Haki.
Nothing is known about this fruit. It is said to be the very first Devil Fruit, a legend so rare that almost no one believes it exists.
